name: Nibbled-On Book
objectiveText: Return the book to Brother Paxton . Nibbled-On Book (Provided)  ( 1 )

comments.body:
You will find this book doing the kobold quest chain in Northshire Valley. This quest's next part will allow you to learn [b]Skinning, Herbalism or Mining[/b] and/or gain skill points for any of these professions. Ultimately this chain will also reward you with a [b]green weapon[/b] of your choice.

Finish all the kobold slaying quests [i](10 vermin, 10 workers, 12 laborers -- that's a lot of mobs in total to drop these books!)[/i] and you'll most likely find all 8 [url=https://www.wowhead.com/forever/item=247839/stolen-book]Stolen Books[/url] without having to farm for them separately.
This questline is heavily influenced by [url=https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Bugs_Bunny]Bugs Bunny[/url] cartoons. I'll add more details in each section.
